He demonstrates each part of the action. He is wearing white football gloves. The other man, wearing a black long-sleeved shirt and pants, is shown going through the same set of actions. The man in black falls to the ground after the deep ball. The man in gray gives a thumbs up. The man in black says he is tired. The man in gray compliments the man in black. Both wear the same logo on their clothes. Text on the wall says "Manchester Metropolitan University Sport." A single cone with "mitre" written on it appears at the end of the video.
